purpose: Machine-readable record of the tests that failed in the suites measured for this commit, so a red baseline can be told apart from a new regression. It does not cover suites that were not run. This is not a list of accepted behaviour: an entry here is a known failure, not a pass.
method: Each suite is run through the repository vitest configuration with the JSON reporter. Only suites actually executed for this commit appear as measured; anything else is listed as unverified with the reason. Counts are never copied forward from an earlier report.

baseline.isolation: vitest.config.ts injects REA_TEST_ISOLATION_ROOTS for every run. That guard covers the destructive client-configuration commands (setup, uninstall, update) and is inert for suites that spawn nothing; it is not a general filesystem sandbox.

attribution_values.confirmed-defect: A real product or harness defect, reproduced and understood.
attribution_values.stale-fixture: The test fixture predates a product change; the product is behaving as designed.
attribution_values.platform-difference: Behaviour differs by host platform and the test does not account for it.
attribution_values.under-investigation: Observed, not yet attributed. Default state.

suites.ci: gate added by this change; not yet observed running in CI
suites.note: Project include is src/{contracts,domain}/**/*.test.ts. Measured on Windows x64; the gate runs on ubuntu-latest, so the Linux lane is unverified until the first CI run.
